summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repository, but nothing was run per instructions, so all changes are unverified by tests. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn; Task.finished_time field; Task.finished now checks finished_time; _reset clears it; update and advance capture elapsed under the lock once completed reaches total; reset clears it explicitly), rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow), rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports and a TYPE_CHECKING table import), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Added entry), tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column; TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns and its expected output regenerated by hand-tracing clock reads and table layout), tests/test_palette.py (new test_rich_cast). Nothing was committed. Caveats: test_columns expected text is hand-derived and unverified; the spec's claim that bar finished styling inherits Task.finished is inaccurate because ProgressBar checks completed against total itself, and I left it unchanged.
